description: Add the user's vote to a public roadmap item (its id from r3_roadmap_list), when the user wants it or it covers what you were about to suggest. One vote per user: an item the user already voted for stays voted, and this never removes a vote. Needs the roadmap:vote right.

id.description: The roadmap item id, from r3_roadmap_list.

name: r3_roadmap_upvote

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Upvote a roadmap item
